Group rides in Plano, TX

21 recurring group rides around Plano, TX: 12 social, 9 road, 2 mixed. 10 roll on weeknights, 8 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Monday Community Ride in Denton — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? PBA Tuesday Night Ladies Ride runs no-drop; C group 15.5–17 mph, D group 14–15.5 mph.
